headline: Türkiye Halts Portfolio Firms and Reviews Fund Repayments
summary: The Turkish market regulator temporarily halted capital market activities of two portfolio management companies as part of liquidation measures, while President Erdoğan prepared to review interim payments to affected investors.
why: Regulatory interventions in Turkey's capital markets impact investor protection and asset management compliance within the financial sector.

impacts.name: Turkish Asset Management
impacts.why: Liquidation measures and suspensions increase compliance scrutiny and restrict operations for local portfolio managers.
